title.narrative: Technical Assistance to operationalise the Capacity Building & Engagement Window of the ¿Enhancing Accountability¿ programme

description.narrative: The purpose of the contract is to provide Technical Assistance to support the EUD and NT in the design, administration and implementation of the Enhancing Accountability Programme. This contract will enable the establishment and operationalisation of Component B of the aforementioned programme, namely the Capacity Building and Engagement Window.
